provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled logistic biomass model dB/dt=r*B*(1-B/K)-q*E*B at fixed nonnegative effort E. At 0<=qE<r use the attracting positive equilibrium; at qE>=r the limiting biomass from any positive starting biomass is zero, including the threshold. Long-run equilibrium yield is qE*B_equilibrium. Compare all candidate efforts; the continuous sustainable-yield optimum may also be obtained analytically. No uncertainty, transient recovery policy or real fishery recommendation is implied.
target: All effort-aligned arrays include the supplied zero and collapse cases. Define collapse threshold as the smallest continuous E for which no strictly positive equilibrium persists. Instantaneous catch is evaluated at the common initial biomass, rather than each design equilibrium.
